BiblicalUsage: One psalm verse: God has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted in Psalm 22:24 — He has not hidden His face, but when the afflicted cried, He heard.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this is the promise for every afflicted heart — God does not despise the cry, He hears it, and the psalm that begins in forsakenness ends in hearing.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
